query:
UPDATE media_files
SET
  media_class = ?,
  media_type = ?,
  maybe_project_type = ?,

  public_bucket_directory_hash = ?,
  maybe_public_bucket_prefix = ?,
  maybe_public_bucket_extension = ?,

  maybe_mime_type = ?,
  file_size_bytes = ?,
  checksum_sha2 = ?,

  creator_ip_address = ?
WHERE token = ?
LIMIT 1
